study_role: Prospective engineering amendment after the v1 run stopped before reference-error computation.

amendment.changed_rule: Non-finite R2 or SNR pixels are counted and made ineligible. No value is interpolated or used as a measurement.
amendment.implementation: Replace non-finite support-map values only at the immutable v1 evaluator boundary with finite values below the locked R2 and SNR thresholds.

selection.rule: Reuse the eight ROIs locked in v1; v1 stopped before any reference-error computation.

claim_boundary: A pass establishes deterministic and bounded-latency production of the already-confirmed PSHG local-orientation endpoint on eight public unstained fields. The amendment repairs support-domain handling only. It does not add independent biological or clinical evidence.
